pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or pyramiding into consecutive tick wicks; secondary orders only authorized if the initial position is already at breakeven + trailing stop.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility filter blocking entries when 5-minute candle range exceeds 2.5x the 20-period average true range.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing micro-locks once floating profit hits +$6.00 to guarantee net green outcomes above the $4-$6 loss ceiling.
